title: Turtle Canyon Snorkel Tour - Semi-private: 6 passenger max
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Guaranteed to see turtles at Turtle Canyon! We carry up to 6 people max, making for an intimate tour experience, while also respecting the animal's space by not over-crowding. We also offer professional photo and/or video package: our photos has been awarded 1st place in Honolulu's Wildlife Magazine, as well as shown on the cover page of the book "The Ocean Speaks". Throughout the tour we'll be educating on Hawaiian culture & wildlife conservation. Our tour is perfect for anybody (adventure seekers, influencers, families with children) looking for a smaller group experience with amazing photos and videos to take home!

DISCLAIMER: We do not drop you right at Turtle Canyon, passengers must follow our guide and swim 10-20 yards to the spot. 

WE CAN NOT CONTROL WEATHER CONDITIONS, OCEAN TIDES, AND OCEAN CURRENTS. We will never run in unsafe and unenjoyable conditions.
